verdict.rationale: Proton Pass is a SaaS password manager with a CLI, so a buyer could fairly ask about versioned APIs and a deprecation policy. The evidence documents only CLI functionality (scripts, CI/CD, CRUD on vaults and items). Nothing in the pack mentions API versioning, a public versioned API, or any deprecation policy, and a CLI is an adjacent feature that earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
